headline: Ownership Actions Continue on Five Principal Fronts
war_summary: The latest returns place Callahan’s Passage at the head of the ownership ledger, with 64 events in the past day, six in the last two hours, and sharply accelerating two-hour casualty and enlistment rates despite a cooler latest hour. Stlican Shelf has also quickened, recording 57 events, seven of them recently; Breaker Town and Fort Hoarfrost account for most of the movement, while the bases remain divided among Wardens, Colonials, and neutral ground. Weathered Expanse reports 39 events and three in the latest two hours, with Frostmarch, Crow’s Nest, and Wightwalk the chief sites of change; its two-hour fighting and enlistment rates are rising. Fisherman’s Row has 51 events, four recent, though current ownership stands at six Colonial bases and three neutral. Mooring County shows five actions in two hours and eleven in the day, with The Wind Hills prominent, while casualty rates have accelerated over two hours. Elsewhere, Nevish Line, Marban Hollow, and other fronts retain older activity without fresh movement; Viper Pit is a heavy casualty front but records no ownership event in the day.
